units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 19:2">Sabb. XIX, 2</cite> <he>לוֹעֵס בשיניו וכ׳</he> one chews (cumin for a plaster) with one’s teeth and applies it.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:8">Tosef. ib. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:8">XIII</cite>), 8 <he>אין לוֹעֲסִין וכ׳</he> you must not chew gum-mastich on the Sabbath.

<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 6:11">Tosef. Pes. VI, 11</cite> <he>כהשמש עומד למזוג … ולועס עד וכ׳</he> (not <he>ללעוס</he>) when the attendant gets up from the table to mix the wine, he must close his mouth and chew (the meat of the Passover lamb) until &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 2:7">Pes. II, 7</cite> <he>לא יִלְעוֹס אדם וכ׳</he> one must not chew wheat (on Pesaḥ) and put it on one’s wound; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>לָעוּס</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:1:11">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵇ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="B00898"><he>בָּלַע</he></cite>.
